title: Depression detection in social media posts using affective and social norm features
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates and benchmarks 'morality features' based on the Moral Foundations Dictionary (MFD) to improve depression detection. It evaluates how features like Harm/Care, Cheating/Fairness, and Betrayal/Loyalty contribute to the model's performance and analyzes the use of moral vocabulary in depressed versus non-depressed individuals.
